dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a concave spline with high curvature intensity characteristic of a falcate profile.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with a moderate pixel radius of curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin follows a linear trajectory at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal baseline.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum pixel base width to vertical pixel height is approximately 1.1:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive light-colored mottled scarring and depigmentation patches across the lateral surface; presence of a small notch on the trailing edge spline near the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive high-contrast mottled pigmentation pattern distributed across the entire visible fin area.
